biography:
Reflections of my ethos:

You have to work hard to discover how to work smart. You won't know the best solutions until you've made nearly all the mistakes. J. Clear. 

Nobody is coming to save you. Get up. Be your own hero.

Skate to where the puck is going to be, not where it has been. Gretzky 

Brave leaders are never silent about hard things. Brené Brown

Execution > credentials

Talk slowly. Observe more. Speak less.

Do what you can, with what you have, where you are. Roosevelt

A man who wants to lead the orchestra must turn his back on the crowd.

Happy are they that hear their detractions and can put them to mending. Shakespeare. 

Great questions are a much better indicator of future success than great answers. Dalio 

The greatest glory in living lies not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall. Mandela

He who has learned to disagree without being disagreeable has discovered the most valuable secret of negotiation. Voss 

Sometimes you don't get what you want because you deserve better. 

Attention, the most important commodity of this century. If you want to influence, don't change people's minds, shift their attention. Greene

Success has many parents, but failure is an orphan. 

More is lost by indecision than wrong decision. Cicero

Believe nothing you hear, and only one half that you see. Edgar Allan Poe. 

You can tell the true character of a man by how his dog and his kids react to him. Shay Carl

Show class, have pride, and display character. If you do, winning takes care of itself. Bear Bryant

Life's tough. Get a helmet. 

Lightning makes no sound until it strikes. MLK Jr.

In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity. Einstein 

A smooth sea never made a skilled sailor. FDR

If we want to direct our lives, we must take control of our consistent actions. It's not what we do once in a while that shapes our lives, but what we do consistently. T. Robbins

Don't mistake activity for achievement. J. Wooden

Before you worry about how to win the game, figure out whether the game is worth winning.

A wise man once said nothing. 

Do not follow where the path may lead. Go instead where there is no path and leave a trail. Ralph Waldo Emerson

Don't cling to a mistake just because you spent a lot of time making it. 

It's amazing what you can accomplish when you do not care who gets the credit. Truman. 

The day before something was a breakthrough it was a crazy idea. 

People do not decide their futures, they decide their habits and their habits decide their futures. F.M. Alexander
